name: somebody wearing your face
description: A person stands here in unremarkable clothes doing an unremarkable thing, and they have your face on. Not a likeness — yours, including the parts you would not have been able to describe.
looks: It is doing your face better than you do. Nothing about it is exaggerated and that is the problem.
When you move your hand, it does not copy you. It is simply somebody else, wearing this.
The expression is one you have never seen from the inside and now recognise instantly.
says: I am not doing anything you would not.
emotes: {it} scratches its cheek — your cheek — and carries on with what it was doing.
{it} catches your eye, gives a small apologetic smile, and looks away first.
{it} adjusts its collar in a gesture you have made perhaps ten thousand times.
asks: How much of today do you actually remember?
